items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: No, I don't remember John. I know him, but my acquaintance with him wasn't real tight you know, but I knew him.

ctx.x: She lived up in the West 70s I guess.

Yeah, yeah, to lay two dollars on Billie, God, I remember Billie when she was making $3,000 a night. Big blue mink coat on, things like that, and then to come by and ask you for a couple of dollars. Looking bad, she looked terrible. Half drunk you know, come by, she used to come by and sit in the Metropole all by herself. People used to say there's Billie Holiday over there. Fella she was going with at the time, Poor John.
